bindings.label: Pruritic and painful periorbital eruption that had lasted 1 month
Patient is a woman in her 70s

Medical history includes lupus nephritis requiring hemodialysis, immune thrombocytopenia, acute myeloid leukemia, chemotherapy-induced peripheral neuropathy, deep vein thrombosis, diverticulitis, and postcolectomy diarrhea
Past treatments included hydroxychloroquine (resulted in retinal toxic effects) and lenalidomide (severely worsened platelet count, with a nadir of 28 × 10^3/μL)
Physical examination demonstrated scaly, crusted pink plaques involving the periorbital skin
Left upper eyelid biopsy shows vacuolar interface dermatitis with follicular involvement and epidermal atrophy
Direct immunofluorescence, anti-dsDNA/C3/C4, bacterial/fungal culture, and HSV PCR results are unavailable
